title: Is there a way to have extra lines for the title on the title screen?

posts.author: james5272
posts.body: I want to have the game title, then have a line break and version number beneath that.  Is there a way to do this?

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body: Not without a plugin. But isn't it easier to just draw the text on the background pictture?

posts.author: james5272
posts.body: For me it'd be easier to just edit the project title in the database every time.  Do you know which plugin would give more title screen control?  Google is saying moghunter at least used to have something for more control over the title screen, but I downloaded his plugin pack and didn't see anything for this.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
1. Don't rename the file.
2. There seems to be unnecessarys eval in SD's code like this:
eval(utSD.DrawTitleCustom.line_1)
I removed it and it works now.
3.  Delete the plugin from the editor and add it again if the parameters are incorrect.

posts.author: Puppet Knight
posts.body:
Posting separate so folks see the notification
Updated the plugin parameters to be a bit more straightforward. No changes to the code were made
Game Title and Subtitle are sectioned off and parameters renamed to be clearer
Added in Larger Default font and outline sizes for each.
I might do some additional tweaks to allow font and outline color changes. But for now i hope this helps
This was fun haha
UPDATE: Added plugin parameters for Font/Outline Colors that accept Color name or Hexidecimal (#123456)
That's all I can think of short of allowing font changes, or changing alignment! Let me know if anyone wants that too
Happy RPG making all!
Additional note, i added in a fix to prevent the first and second lines from overlappingg based on the font sizes of the titles, as well as a Y offset option for both titles to be used as needed.
